title: Boundary scenario 'desired-move-in-date-too-far-future' now submits a VALID date ({MOVE_IN_DATE} = today+90d) while expecting validation_error — fails every run and drops the upper-bound E2E pin
evidence:
Worktree scenario file (lines 17-24): 'expected_outcome: validation_error
expected_error_fields:
  - desired_move_in_date
form_data:
  first_name: "Test"
  last_name: "User"
  email: "test+{SCENARIO}-{RUN_ID}@example.com"
  desired_move_in_date: "{MOVE_IN_DATE}"' — and SKILL.md line 279 defines the template as a valid date: '- `{MOVE_IN_DATE}` — today + 90 days (YYYY-MM-DD, computed at fill time). **Every non-validation scenario must use this for `desired_move_in_date`** — hardcoded calendar dates go stale and the server rejects past dates (the whole suite went red on this once, 2026-08). Only the boundary-validation scenarios (`desired-move-in-date-in-past`, `-too-far-future`) pin literal dates on purpose.' — and application_handler.gleam:331 confirms the ceiling the scenario must exceed: '// dates more than 12 months out are rejected so the landlord's leaderboard'
detail: The diff changed this scenario's date from literal "2030-01-01" to {MOVE_IN_DATE} (today+90d), which passes the server's 12-month ceiling. The submission now succeeds, so the expected validation_error never appears (scenario goes red), and the upper-bound branch of validate_move_in_date loses its only E2E pin. The same diff's SKILL.md explicitly exempts this scenario from the template, and the scenario's own stale 'Yearly maintenance: bump 2030' note still references the removed literal.
recommended_fix: Revert line 24 to a literal far-future date beyond the 12-month ceiling (e.g. desired_move_in_date: "2030-01-01"), matching the in-past companion scenario and the SKILL.md boundary-scenario exemption.
